The '''Resource Management Council''' was a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] committee in operation after the institution of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and during the [[Cold War]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vuub]] was a member of this council.
